# Abhijith P A — Abi Solutions

> Abhijith P A is a full stack developer and AI engineer in Wayanad, Kerala, India, and the founder of Abi Solutions. He builds websites, web apps, ERP systems, SaaS platforms and AI automation (WhatsApp and Telegram bots, LLM integrations) with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Django, Python, Node.js, PostgreSQL and AWS. He works with businesses in Wayanad (Kalpetta, Sulthan Bathery, Mananthavady), Kozhikode, Kochi and with remote clients worldwide.

Contact: abhijithabhijith1999@gmail.com · +91 99613 16468 · WhatsApp https://wa.me/919961316468 · usual reply time under 24 hours.
